diagnosis.summary: Payment-service p95 latency has spiked from 110 ms to 2900 ms, a 26x rise, and order-service is reflecting the same slowdown in its calls to payment-service. Order-service is now returning 5xx errors to 16.7% of its requests, up from zero. The incident has been active for 2 minutes.
diagnosis.root_cause: Severe latency degradation inside payment-service's handler is the most likely root cause, with order-service's dependency calls slowing and failing as a result of payment-service's own slowdown.
evidence: Payment-service p95 latency rose from 110 ms to 2900 ms, a 26x increase over baseline.
Order-service p95 time spent calling payment-service rose from 112 ms to 2950 ms (also 26x), closely matching payment-service's own p95 latency.
Order-service dependency error count rose from 0 to 57 per minute, indicating calls to payment-service are failing or timing out.
Order-service 5xx error rate rose from 0.0 to 0.167, meaning 16.7% of order-service requests are now returning server errors.
Order-service p95 end-to-end latency rose from 130 ms to 2950 ms, a 22.7x increase over baseline.
Payment-service p95 latency rose above its baseline at 14:32:00, and order-service 5xx errors rose above baseline 40 seconds later (observed sequence from correlated timestamps).
recommended_actions: Inspect payment-service CloudWatch Logs at /aws/lambda/anomalypulse-payment for errors or slow execution starting at 14:32:00 to identify what is slowing the handler.
Check payment-service lambda_throttle_count in CloudWatch; if throttling is present, assign reserved concurrency to payment-service to protect its capacity.
Check payment-service lambda_duration_ms_mean and lambda_duration_ms_p95 to confirm whether time is being spent inside the handler body or elsewhere in the invocation path.
After identifying and fixing the payment-service issue, recheck dependency_error_count and order-service error_rate_5xx to confirm recovery before making any further changes.
Do not add retries to order-service's call to payment-service while payment-service is degraded, as additional invocations will worsen the load on the struggling dependency.
